lane: holdout-DTI (hide-and-recover holdout; alpha=0.2 FP / beta=0.8 FN; 300 m triangular kernel; 3 px at 100 m)
hypothesis: H72-1: off-catalogue USGS SGMC 1:24k/1:250k geologic-map fault traces, emitted only where absent from the competition catalogue and dot-thinned at 280 m, capture geothermal-indicative faults missing from the USGS/INGENIOUS labels.
mechanism: SGMC traces are dilated 1 px (inside the 300 m kernel of a 1 px-wide truth line), dot-thinned with Poisson-disk min_dist=2.8 px so no two dots compete for one truth pixel, then masked pixel-exactly on labels.tif; score = pooled DTI over 8 spatially-blocked draws (4 quadrants x draws 20/21, 20% of segments hidden behind a 1.5 km collar).
named_non_fault_mimic_process: lithologic / map-unit boundaries drawn as fault linework on geologic maps (non-tectonic contacts mimicking faults)
